review_scope: source-supported guidance; not locally field validated

first_edible_harvest_days.note: NIHORT manuals vary by variety and cutting approach; range combines its four-week and 35–45 day statements

profiles.climate: Warm tropical conditions; adequate moisture and drainage
profiles.planting: Sow vegetable amaranth seed into a prepared, well-drained bed or suitable container; thin crowded seedlings and maintain moisture without waterlogging.
care: Watch for insect feeding and leaf damage
profiles.harvest: Harvest tender leaves or shoots when suitable for eating; repeated cutting depends on spacing and variety.
food_safety: Wash harvested vegetables with safe water
Do not use contaminated water or untreated waste on edible crops
profiles.limits: NIHORT field guidance does not validate exact container size, sowing depth, watering volume, or local planting month for each Nigerian state.

profiles.planting: Select verified jute mallow seed and prepare well-drained soil; follow local extension guidance for planting depth and spacing.
profiles.harvest: Harvest tender leaves at an appropriate locally verified stage; do not promise a fixed number of days.
food_safety: Cook according to household food practices
profiles.limits: NIHORT lists a Corchorus production guide; detailed numeric claims have not yet been checked against its full manual.

profiles.climate: Warm humid locations with adequate space and water; validate locally
profiles.planting: Use locally appropriate planting material and adequate growing space; vines require management.
care: Provide space or suitable support for vines
profiles.harvest: Harvest edible tender leaves when established, based on verified local guidance; do not assume a 40-day harvest.
food_safety: Do not eat unidentified plant parts
